title: ISRO SDSC SHAR Various Post Recruitment 2026
summary: Indian Space Research Organization ISRO has released a notification on its official website for the Recruitment of Examination of Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Library Assistant ‘A’, Nurse ‘B’, Technician ‘B’, Draughtsman ‘B’, Fireman ‘A’, Light Vehicle Driver ‘A’, Heavy Vehicle Driver ‘A’ and Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Posts. This recruitment is for 97 positions. The ISRO application form has started on 19 October 2026 , and candidates can apply until 09 November 2026 . Candidates must check the complete details for ISRO SDSC SHAR Various Post Recruitment 2026 Provided below. ( Advt. No. SDSC SHAR/RMT/03/2026 )
organization: ISRO has released a notification on its official website for the Recruitment of Examination of Technical Assistant, Scientific Assistant, Library Assistant ‘A’, Nurse ‘B’, Technician ‘B’, Draughtsman ‘B’, Fireman ‘A’, Light Vehicle Driver ‘A’, Heavy Vehicle Driver ‘A’ and Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Posts. qualification: Candidates must have a First Class Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical / Computer Science / Electronics & Communication / Civil Engineering from a recognized University / Institution.
